en: "Wow, amaaazing! This is the first time{n} in my whole life that I've ever{n} seen such a huge door!"
"And those statues standing over there{n} seem to be gods from the ancient{n} legends, buuut...?"
"Oh my?"
"Hector's keepsake ring seems{n} to be resonating with{n} the six statues?"
"Oh my? What's going to happen?{n} A strange light turned into the{n} shape of gods in no time at aaall?"
"My name is Beauty God Venus!"
"My name is Sky God Uranus!"
"My name is Sun God Apollo!"
"My name is War God Ares!"
"My name is Silence God Selene!"
"My name is Sea God Poseidon!"
"You who seek the right to be agent of{n} the gods, who seek the rings of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods that seal our power!"
"Your trial is not yet over!"
"If you would go on from here, know{n} that there are but two paths!"
"One!"
"Either bind the six rings into one{n} and show them before us!"
"Or!"
"Cast away every last one of the rings!"
"Gather the rings or throw them away?{n} That's awfully rough, but I sort of{n} understand what they mean."
"So only the chosen, or those who have{n} cast off desire, can go on from here...{n} That's what it means, isn't it?"
"Seek out the statues..."
"In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Of the Twelve Gods' statues, first{n} find the six of us, and turn{n} our power into rings."
"Then shall the way be opened!"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"Anyway, unless we gather six rings,{n} it seems we can't even go any further,{n} let alone get the Almighty Treasure."
"But that really surprised me!"
"Making images float up in midair...{n} The gods of long ago really were{n} amazing people, weren't they?"
"Ah, not people, gods, buuut."
"What are you talking about, {name:6}?{n} This sort of thing is just a sliver of{n} the gods' power. A parlor trick..."
"The Almighty Treasure in this island's{n} depths is the power to control weather{n} and climate, and remake the world at will."
"No wonder countries everywhere are{n} so desperate to collect the rings."
"True... it's a miraculous art...{n} ...but this art of the gods... strangely...{n} gives off... the smell of death..."
"Did you know, Miss {name:6}?"
"What is truly astonishing about the{n} tools the gods made is that they are{n} wholly unaffected by the flow of time."
"The flow of time...?"
"Weathering, infrared degradation, every{n} kind of aging removed: tools that{n} truly possess eternal life."
"That art became possible only by{n} altering the space around a tool and{n} cutting it off from time outside."
"Yet because of that, they now sow{n} the seeds of war in the age of humans."
"Tools that are too advanced do not{n} always serve happiness. Do you{n} not think so, Miss {name:6}?"
"No... um... well...{n} ...I don't understand{n} any of that at aaall..."
"It looks like a mere memory device,{n} but it's properly reacting{n} to what we do."
"It replays records and judges for{n} itself, and what it says differs{n} each time. An artificial personality..."
"Now this is truly the work of gods!"
"A fine reference for my Item Studies!"
"Zodiac... Twelve Gods..."
"No good. I should have heard of them,{n} but the memory is lost. The key{n} points, I cannot recall at all."
"Truly, this is an art of mystery."
"Feng shui reads the ki of wind and{n} water. This art bends such natural{n} phenomena to its will and remakes them."
"Anyway, let's hurry ooon!"
"If we don't hurry, someone else will{n} take the remaining rings!{n} Let's turn back for nooow!"
"You who seek the right to be agent of{n} the gods, who seek the rings of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods that seal our power!"
"Your trial is not yet over!"
"Of the twelve, the keys to this path,{n} the six rings that are the substance{n} of us six demigods, are unsealed!"
"And yet!"
"They are not yet bound into one!"
"That's right. No matter what I did,{n} I couldn't gather all six."
"There is ever but one agent of the gods!"
"Therefore, in the name of the Zodiac{n} Twelve Gods, show before us, here,{n} your power as agent of the gods..."
"That, we declare, is the final{n} trial given unto you!"
"What on earth is going to happen?"
"A forced teleport!?{n} Tch! Where the hell is this!?"
"Oh my, and you are?"
"Then you're the one holding the rest{n} of the rings of the Twelve Gods{n} that I couldn't gather, aren't you?"
"There is ever but one agent of the gods!"
"Take up arms against each other, and{n} now cross swords in fierce contest!"
"Know that mighty power exists for{n} one reason: to set right the course{n} of the world!"
"The one who survives the battle{n} before the gods is the true agent!{n} Come! Take up your arms, both of you!"
"And make an offering to us{n} of each other's fresh blood!"
"No waaay!? Fight each other!?{n} Are the Zodiac Twelve Gods telling{n} us to commit murdeeer?"
"I see..."
"If that's what the gods have to say,{n} I can pretty much guess what this{n} island's Almighty Treasure is like..."
"Buuut..."
"Maybe it's a bluff."
"What do you meeean?"
"They could be egging us on to fight on{n} purpose, while really just watching{n} to see if we actually do it."
"And then they'd say:"
"'Scum who take my words at face value{n} and really kill each other can never{n} become agents of the gods.'"
"Maybe so..."
"Time and again, you've told me that{n} my thinking is naive. So I tried{n} thinking things over a little myself."
"If the Zodiac Twelve Gods were truly{n} righteous gods, I think they'd never have{n} told humans of the Almighty Treasure."
"Something that could only spark strife."
"Since the armies came onto this{n} island, how many people have died,{n} my husband Hector among them?"
"Ten? A hundred? A thousand?"
"If the Zodiac Twelve Gods were righteous{n} gods, they could surely use the Almighty{n} Treasure to stop even the war."
"I see..."
"That's right! It has to be sooo!"
"If there were righteous gods on this{n} island, Hector would never have died{n} in the first place!"
"Could be..."
"Looks like you've grown up a little.{n} You're finally starting to see{n} how the world works, aren't you?"
"Oh, honestly! 'Grown up,' he says!{n} I'll have you know I'm 29!"
"Sorry about that, old lady."
"And I'm not an old lady eitheeer!"
"If the Zodiac Twelve Gods were truly{n} righteous gods, I think they'd never have{n} told humans of the Almighty Treasure."
"Something that could only spark strife."
"I suppose so..."
"Not that I seriously think the Zodiac{n} Twelve Gods are righteous gods, either."
"Well, either way, it's nothing{n} I care about."
"All I've cared about from the start{n} is the Almighty Treasure sleeping{n} on this island."
"...What is the matter?"
"You who aspire to be{n} the agent of the gods?"
"The course of the world{n} is falling into disorder."
"To set it right is the very..."
"To set{w:1}..."
"Oh my? What's happened?"
"This destructive power isn't magic!{n} I didn't sense any bloodlust, either!{n} So it's not a special move!"
"Naval guns! It's naval gunfire!"
"From the sea, then!?"
"Yeah, they're shelling from outside{n} the island of steel!"
"Then there's no way to fight baaack!"
"Are they aiming at us?"
"No. Not at us so much as shelling{n} every key point on this{n} island of steel, I'd say..."
"It's standard before a big landing.{n} Naval guns blow away the mines and{n} obstacles to clear the infantry's path."
"Then...?"
"Yeah. It was only special forces{n} until now, but they've run out of{n} patience. A full-scale army's coming."
"So this island of steel becomes{n} more and more of a chaotic{n} battlefield, doesn't it?"
"That's about it."
"What do we do, Diana!? At this{n} rate, never mind the rings, I don't know{n} if we can even escape from here..."
"Not my problem..."
"Huh?"
"Whether you lot live or die,{n} it's got nothing to do{n} with me anymore."
"What's gotten into you!?"
"Nothing's gotten into me. I've been a{n} freelance bounty hunter from the start.{n} Pay me enough and I'll take any job."
"My contract with you ends here.{n} From now on, I start a job for another{n} employer I'd already taken on."
"Ngh!?"
"At this rate I can't carry out the{n} mission! What does Special Service{n} HQ have to say!?"
"Special Service HQ, huh..."
"Hey? Ixion!?"
"You've done good work until now,{n} {hero:6}. But your job ends here."
"What do you mean!?"
"That is..."
"Diana, you...?"
"I always trusted you as{n} a reliable companion..."
"Naive. Way too naive, missus."
"You carelessly trusted someone you met{n} by chance for the first time. You were{n} too naive from the start, that's all."
"Other people always betray you someday.{n} No, even when they don't, in the end{n} it looks like they betrayed you."
"You didn't know that."
"Anyone who isn't you, even if they{n} look the same at first glance, always{n} thinks differently somewhere."
"Even if it's small at first, the{n} difference slowly grows into a big rift,{n} until you're hopelessly at odds."
"That's when people feel betrayed."
"Funny, isn't it? All along, you were{n} only pushing your own selfish wishes{n} onto the other person."
"Hector was someone else too, but{n} he and I truly understood each other."
"He's only a dead man, after all."
"The dead never betray anyone. He's not{n} the real thing anymore. In the end,{n} he's nothing but your imagination."
"If your hubby were still alive..."
"By now he might be head over heels for{n} some other woman, and you'd see it{n} and feel betrayed."
"That's not true!"
"Well, whatever."
"Now then..."
"What!?"
"What's wrong!?"
"My ring? My ring of the{n} Twelve Gods is gone!?"
"Oops, sorry, {hero:6}. During that{n} shelling just now, I helped{n} myself to it."
"Knight or not, you trust your own{n} skill too much. Outside a fight,{n} you're wide open, you know?"
"Diana, that Romulus soldier{n} over there is your real{n} employer, isn't he?"
"Well, that's how it is."
"So that is how it was..."
"But I cannot hand the rings of the{n} Twelve Gods, or the Almighty Treasure,{n} over to the likes of you!"
"Please, take up your weapon!"
"Let's settle this here!"
"Sorry, I've got no time for that.{n} Looks like the shelling's about{n} to start up again."
"Well, why don't you get blown away by{n} the naval guns and go be with your{n} hubby in the next world?"
"Diana!"
"See ya!"
"Ixion, you bastard! You're the{n} one I'll never forgive!"
"Don't make such a scary face,{n} {hero:6}."
"Oh, I forgot to tell you. It's not{n} just the ring. I've taken{n} your companions, too."
"What?"
"The Rhodes army used a legacy of an{n} ancient civilization to make bio-modified{n} weapons by the name of Esper Dolls."
"Without your knowing, the Special{n} Service Agency got hold of part{n} of that secret..."
"And I used it to tinker with your{n} companions' minds, just a tiny bit.{n} That's all there is to it."
"You bastard...!?"
"You turned people into puppets!?"
"Don't be stupid, {hero:6}. People{n} are nothing but puppets anyway,{n} aren't they?"
"Orders from parents, husbands, bosses,{n} superior officers, or orders you{n} make yourself, called taboos."
"Living by obeying things like that...{n} Aren't they pitiful, sad creatures?"
"So, you see..."
"So I'm just giving them{n} the orders in their place..."
"This, too, is my revenge."
"Ixion! I'll fucking kill you!"
"You can't, {hero:6}. The naval guns{n} will open up again any moment. It's a{n} real shame, but this is goodbye."
"Farewell, my friend... as they say."
"Hahahahaha!"
"Diana, please wait!"
"Hey, Ixion!"
September 1, Divine Calendar 4199
